judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the failing acceptance test, updated the spec, and added a `.lore/dod.md` file, completely omitting the actual implementation fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because the production code still gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error`, the newly added test will fail and `npm test` (as well as `npm run eslint` due to missing `require-yield` suppression on the generator stub) will not pass. Furthermore, the candidate failed to update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria, left the new spec guarantee under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section instead of promoting it to the main spec list, and created a separate `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file instead of adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
